title: MemoryOps curated troubleshooting pack
provenance: Original summaries of widely documented operational behaviour, written for MemoryOps. Not copied from any source. 'references' point to official documentation for verification.

entries.title: 502 Bad Gateway from a reverse proxy or load balancer
symptoms: proxy logs upstream connect error or upstream prematurely closed
errors started suddenly across many endpoints
likely_causes: upstream application instances crashed or are restarting
upstream listening on a different port or address than the proxy expects
upstream closing keep-alive connections before the proxy does
diagnostic_checks: check whether upstream instances are running and passing health checks
compare the upstream address and port in proxy config with what the app listens on
check proxy error log for connect refused versus reset by peer
confirming_signals: proxy error log shows connection refused or reset
disconfirming_signals: upstream is healthy and its own logs show the requests completing
common_failed_actions: increasing proxy timeouts when the upstream is actually down
safe_remediation_guidance: set proxy keep-alive timeout lower than upstream idle timeout
warnings: a 502 is reported by the proxy, the fault is usually behind it

entries.title: 503 Service Unavailable during traffic or deploys
symptoms: errors during rollouts or traffic peaks
likely_causes: no ready instances behind the service or load balancer
diagnostic_checks: count ready instances and endpoints behind the service
check readiness probe results during the rollout
check whether errors align with deploy or traffic peaks
disconfirming_signals: plenty of ready endpoints and low load while 503 continues
common_failed_actions: scaling out when instances fail readiness for a config reason
safe_remediation_guidance: use rolling updates with max unavailable low enough to keep capacity
warnings: 503 with Retry-After can be intentional load shedding

entries.title: 504 Gateway Timeout from proxy
symptoms: requests take exactly the proxy timeout before failing
likely_causes: upstream slower than the proxy read timeout
a dependency of the upstream (database, external API) is slow
thread or worker pool exhaustion upstream
diagnostic_checks: compare request duration histogram with the proxy timeout value
trace a slow request to find which dependency consumes the time
check upstream worker utilisation
confirming_signals: durations cluster exactly at the timeout
a dependency span dominates the trace
disconfirming_signals: upstream finishes quickly but the proxy still times out (look at network path instead)
common_failed_actions: raising the proxy timeout without finding the slow dependency
safe_remediation_guidance: fix or bound the slow dependency with its own timeout
warnings: longer timeouts can hold more connections open and worsen overload

entries.title: 500 errors immediately after a deployment
symptoms: 500 internal server error rate rises right after release
stack traces reference new code paths
likely_causes: code regression in the new release
diagnostic_checks: diff the release (code and config) against the previous version
group errors by endpoint and exception type
check migration status
confirming_signals: errors started at the deploy timestamp
exceptions point to changed code or missing config
disconfirming_signals: error rate unchanged by deploy timing
same errors on the previous version
common_failed_actions: restarting instances of the new version
safe_remediation_guidance: roll back or feature-flag off the change
fix the regression forward with a test
warnings: rolling back code does not undo an irreversible migration

entries.title: 429 Too Many Requests from an API
symptoms: bursts of failures at the top of the minute
likely_causes: client exceeded provider or gateway rate limit
a shared key or IP used by many clients
diagnostic_checks: count request rate per key or IP against the documented limit
check whether retries honour Retry-After
check for a new caller sharing the credentials
disconfirming_signals: rate far below limit (check which limit applies)
safe_remediation_guidance: add exponential backoff with jitter honouring Retry-After
spread load or request a higher quota
warnings: aggressive retries turn a small limit breach into an outage

entries.title: Sudden spike of 401 Unauthorized
likely_causes: credential or signing key rotated and not propagated
clock skew makes valid tokens look expired
diagnostic_checks: check recent credential or key rotations
decode a failing token and compare exp, nbf and kid with the verifier
compare server clocks
confirming_signals: failures began at a rotation time
kid in token unknown to verifier
disconfirming_signals: tokens valid and clocks in sync
common_failed_actions: asking users to log in again repeatedly
safe_remediation_guidance: distribute the new key or credential to every consumer
allow overlap of old and new keys during rotation
warnings: never log full tokens while debugging

entries.title: 403 Forbidden after a permission or policy change
symptoms: only some users or services affected
likely_causes: role or policy changed or removed
resource moved to a scope without grants
new security rule blocking a path
diagnostic_checks: identify the principal making the failing request
list its effective permissions
compare policies with the last working version
disconfirming_signals: principal has the permission and the resource policy allows it
common_failed_actions: granting broad admin rights to make it work
safe_remediation_guidance: restore the specific missing permission with least privilege
warnings: broad grants made during incidents are often never removed

entries.title: 404 Not Found after routing or deploy change
symptoms: 404 not found for endpoints that used to work
only new or moved routes affected
likely_causes: route prefix or base path changed
diagnostic_checks: request the path directly on an instance bypassing the proxy
compare proxy rewrite rules with the previous version
list deployed assets
confirming_signals: path works directly but not through proxy
safe_remediation_guidance: restore the path mapping or rewrite
add a route smoke test to the pipeline
warnings: 404 caching at a CDN can outlive the fix

entries.title: 413 Payload Too Large on uploads
symptoms: large uploads fail while small ones work
failures after moving behind a new proxy
likely_causes: proxy or gateway body size limit lower than the application limit
diagnostic_checks: find the smallest failing request size
check body size limits at each hop (CDN, load balancer, proxy, app)
confirming_signals: failures begin exactly above a size threshold
disconfirming_signals: failures occur for small bodies too
safe_remediation_guidance: align body size limits at every hop to the intended maximum
warnings: very large limits expose the service to memory pressure

example_fix.label: GENERAL EXAMPLE
example_fix.diff:
- PROXY_MAX_BODY_SIZE=<current limit>
+ PROXY_MAX_BODY_SIZE=<intended maximum upload size>

entries.title: 431 Request Header Fields Too Large
symptoms: only some clients or users with many cookies fail
likely_causes: cookies or tokens grew beyond the header limit
diagnostic_checks: measure header size of failing requests
check header buffer limits at gateway and proxy
confirming_signals: failing requests have much larger cookie or authorization headers
warnings: raising limits hides unbounded cookie growth

entries.title: Browser requests blocked by CORS
symptoms: requests work from curl but not from the web app
likely_causes: origin not in allowed origins after domain change
preflight not handled for new headers or methods
diagnostic_checks: inspect the preflight response headers
compare the page origin with the allowed list
check whether credentials mode is include
confirming_signals: missing Access-Control-Allow-Origin for the page origin
common_failed_actions: disabling CORS checks in the browser
safe_remediation_guidance: allow the exact origin and required headers
warnings: allowing any origin with credentials is a security risk

entries.title: p99 latency spike while averages look fine
likely_causes: lock contention on a hot resource
diagnostic_checks: break down latency by instance and endpoint
correlate slow requests with GC or lock metrics
check retry counts
confirming_signals: one instance or shard dominates slow requests
disconfirming_signals: slow requests evenly spread with no resource correlation
common_failed_actions: adding instances without finding the slow component
safe_remediation_guidance: isolate or replace the slow instance
warnings: averages hide user-visible pain

entries.title: API slower right after a release
symptoms: database or downstream calls per request increased
likely_causes: cache key or cache usage changed
diagnostic_checks: compare queries or downstream calls per request before and after
check cache hit rate
profile the new code path
confirming_signals: calls per request increased at deploy time
disconfirming_signals: per-request work unchanged, only traffic increased
safe_remediation_guidance: roll back or fix the regressed path
warnings: scaling can mask a regression until traffic grows further

entries.title: Retry storm amplifying an outage
symptoms: request volume multiplied during an incident
errors persist after the original cause is fixed
diagnostic_checks: compare incoming request rate with normal
count retry attempts per original request
check retry settings at each layer
confirming_signals: traffic several times normal with high retry counts
safe_remediation_guidance: add backoff with jitter and retry budgets
warnings: retries are load

entries.title: Intermittent connection reset or empty reply behind a load balancer
likely_causes: load balancer idle timeout shorter than client or server keep-alive
server closes idle connections the client still reuses
diagnostic_checks: compare idle timeouts at client, load balancer and server
check whether errors follow idle periods
confirming_signals: resets happen on reused connections after idle
disconfirming_signals: resets on fresh connections under load
safe_remediation_guidance: make the server keep-alive longer than the load balancer idle timeout, or the client shorter
warnings: mismatched timeouts produce rare, hard-to-reproduce errors

entries.title: Database refuses connections: too many clients
symptoms: errors like too many clients already or remaining connection slots are reserved
new requests fail while existing ones work
likely_causes: sum of application pool sizes exceeds max_connections
many idle connections from old instances
diagnostic_checks: count connections by application and state
multiply instances by pool size and compare with max_connections
look for idle connections from terminated deploys
confirming_signals: total configured pools exceed server limit
safe_remediation_guidance: add a connection pooler or cap pools per instance
warnings: each database connection costs memory
high limits can cause memory pressure

entries.title: Application pool acquire timeouts
symptoms: timeout acquiring a connection from the pool
likely_causes: pool size too small for concurrency
connections held too long by slow queries or transactions
pool size changed in a release
diagnostic_checks: compare current pool size with the last known-good configuration
check pool wait time and active count
find long-held connections
disconfirming_signals: pool mostly idle while timeouts continue
safe_remediation_guidance: restore the pool size to the last known-good value if it changed
warnings: a bigger pool shifts pressure to the database
stay within max_connections

entries.title: Requests stuck waiting on locks
likely_causes: long transaction holding a row or table lock
diagnostic_checks: list blocking and blocked sessions
identify the oldest open transaction
check running migrations or batch jobs
disconfirming_signals: no blocked sessions in lock views
safe_remediation_guidance: end or shorten the blocking transaction
run heavy changes in batches or off-peak
warnings: terminating a session rolls back its work

entries.title: Deadlocks after a code change
likely_causes: two code paths lock the same rows in different orders
new batch job conflicts with online traffic
diagnostic_checks: read the deadlock log entries to find the two statements
compare lock order across code paths
confirming_signals: deadlock logs name the same tables from two paths
safe_remediation_guidance: lock rows in a consistent order
warnings: blind retries without fixing order keep failing under load

entries.title: Idle in transaction sessions holding resources
likely_causes: application opens a transaction and waits on external calls
error path forgets to roll back
diagnostic_checks: list sessions by state and transaction age
find which application holds them
confirming_signals: long-lived idle in transaction sessions from one service
safe_remediation_guidance: fix the code path to commit or roll back promptly
warnings: timeouts that kill sessions may surface as application errors

entries.title: Read replica lag causing stale reads
symptoms: users see old data after writing
likely_causes: long query on replica conflicting with replay
diagnostic_checks: check replica lag and its timeline against batch jobs
check replay conflicts
confirming_signals: lag rises during a bulk job
disconfirming_signals: lag stays low while stale reads continue (check caching)
warnings: failover to a lagging replica loses recent writes

entries.title: Database disk full from write-ahead log growth
diagnostic_checks: list replication slots and their retained WAL
check archive status
check oldest transaction
confirming_signals: an inactive slot retains most WAL
common_failed_actions: deleting log files by hand from the data directory
safe_remediation_guidance: remove the stale slot or fix archiving
warnings: never delete WAL files manually

entries.title: Queries slow after bulk load: stale statistics
likely_causes: planner statistics are stale after bulk changes
autovacuum or analyze has not caught up
diagnostic_checks: compare the query plan now with before
check last analyze time for the tables
safe_remediation_guidance: run ANALYZE on the affected tables
warnings: very large tables can take time to analyze

entries.title: Slow query from missing index
symptoms: query time grows with table size
likely_causes: filter or join column not indexed
index not used due to type mismatch or function on column
diagnostic_checks: run EXPLAIN on the slow query
check which scan type is used and row counts
confirming_signals: sequential scan over a large table for a selective filter
warnings: index creation can lock writes unless built concurrently

entries.title: N+1 queries after an ORM change
symptoms: page slower for accounts with more data
hundreds of small queries per request
likely_causes: lazy loading issues one query per item
diagnostic_checks: count queries per request
inspect the ORM loading strategy on the changed path
confirming_signals: query count scales with item count
safe_remediation_guidance: load related rows in bulk with eager loading
warnings: eager loading everything can overfetch

entries.title: Migration locks a hot table during deploy
symptoms: writes to one table time out during migration
likely_causes: schema change requires an exclusive lock
migration waits behind a long transaction and blocks others
diagnostic_checks: check running migration statements and their lock waits
confirming_signals: migration waiting for or holding an exclusive lock
safe_remediation_guidance: use online migration patterns and lock timeouts
warnings: a queued exclusive lock blocks readers too

entries.title: Integer primary key or sequence exhausted
symptoms: inserts fail with out of range or duplicate key errors
likely_causes: 32-bit integer column reached its maximum value
diagnostic_checks: check the current sequence value against the column type maximum
safe_remediation_guidance: migrate the column to a 64-bit type with a planned migration
warnings: the migration on large tables needs careful online execution

entries.title: Prepared statement errors behind a transaction pooler
symptoms: prepared statement does not exist errors
errors after introducing a connection pooler
likely_causes: transaction-level pooling breaks session features like prepared statements
diagnostic_checks: check pooler mode
check whether the driver uses server-side prepared statements
confirming_signals: pooler in transaction mode and driver prepares statements
safe_remediation_guidance: disable server-side prepares or use session pooling for that client
warnings: session pooling reduces connection savings

entries.title: Connections explode after application autoscaling
symptoms: too many connections during traffic spike
likely_causes: every new instance opens a full pool
diagnostic_checks: compute instances times pool size at peak
compare with database limit
common_failed_actions: raising the database connection limit alone
safe_remediation_guidance: cap max instances or per-instance pool
warnings: autoscaling the app can overload a fixed-size database

entries.title: Table and index bloat slowing queries
symptoms: table size grows without more rows
likely_causes: frequent updates or deletes with vacuum unable to keep up
diagnostic_checks: compare live versus dead tuples
check oldest transaction age
warnings: full rewrites lock tables

entries.title: Keys disappear because Redis evicts under memory pressure
likely_causes: maxmemory reached with an eviction policy that removes any key
cache data sharing an instance with sessions
diagnostic_checks: check used memory against maxmemory
check eviction policy and evicted keys counter
confirming_signals: evicted keys rising while memory at limit
safe_remediation_guidance: use a no-eviction policy for data that must persist
warnings: noeviction makes writes fail when full

entries.title: Redis rejects writes: OOM command not allowed
diagnostic_checks: check memory usage and key count growth
sample keys without TTL
confirming_signals: memory at maxmemory with many non-expiring keys
common_failed_actions: flushing the whole database during an incident
warnings: flushing loses session and queue data

entries.title: Redis latency spikes from slow commands or big keys
diagnostic_checks: review the slow log
find big keys
correlate spikes with persistence snapshots
confirming_signals: slow log shows KEYS or large range commands
safe_remediation_guidance: replace full scans with incremental scans
warnings: blocking commands stall every client

entries.title: Duplicate processing after cache or Redis failover
likely_causes: idempotency or dedupe keys lost during failover
diagnostic_checks: check failover time against duplicates
check idempotency key hit rate
confirming_signals: dedupe hit rate dropped at failover
safe_remediation_guidance: make consumers idempotent with durable keys
warnings: in-memory dedupe is not durable

entries.title: Cache hit rate collapsed after deploy
diagnostic_checks: compare cache keys written and read by new code
check hit rate timeline against deploy
confirming_signals: hit rate dropped at deploy time
warnings: a full cold cache can cause a stampede

entries.title: Cache stampede when popular keys expire
symptoms: periodic load spikes on the database
likely_causes: many requests recompute the same expired key simultaneously
diagnostic_checks: correlate spikes with key expiry times
count duplicate concurrent queries
confirming_signals: identical queries in bursts at expiry
safe_remediation_guidance: add request coalescing or early refresh
warnings: synchronized expiry across keys amplifies spikes

entries.title: Stale data served from cache after a fix
symptoms: fix deployed but users still see old results
clearing one key fixes one user
diagnostic_checks: check TTL on affected keys
check invalidation on the write path
warnings: mass invalidation can stampede the backend

entries.title: Redis max clients reached
symptoms: max number of clients reached errors
likely_causes: connection leak or pool per request
diagnostic_checks: count clients by source
check pooling configuration
confirming_signals: client count at limit from one service
warnings: restarting Redis drops in-memory data unless persisted

entries.title: CDN serving stale or wrong content
symptoms: users in some regions see old assets
likely_causes: cache key ignores a varying header
diagnostic_checks: request the asset from several edges and compare headers
check cache-control from origin
confirming_signals: edges return old content with long max-age
warnings: versioned asset names avoid purge dependence

entries.title: Region-specific slowness after routing or DNS change
symptoms: slow only for users in one region
started after DNS or CDN change
likely_causes: traffic routed to a distant origin
diagnostic_checks: resolve the hostname from affected regions
check which edge or origin serves them
confirming_signals: region resolves to a far origin
warnings: DNS TTLs delay recovery

entries.title: CPU saturation causing slow responses
diagnostic_checks: profile CPU on a busy instance
correlate with traffic and deploys
list top processes
confirming_signals: one function or process dominates CPU
disconfirming_signals: CPU low while latency high (look at dependencies)
safe_remediation_guidance: fix the hot path or add capacity
move background jobs off serving nodes
warnings: autoscaling on CPU lags sudden spikes

entries.title: CPU throttling from container limits
symptoms: latency spikes while CPU usage looks moderate
likely_causes: container CPU limit too low for bursty work
diagnostic_checks: check CPU throttling metrics per container
compare limits before and after the change
safe_remediation_guidance: raise CPU limits or remove hard limits for latency-sensitive services
warnings: removing limits can let noisy neighbours starve others

entries.title: Memory leak: memory grows until restart
symptoms: restarts fix it for a while
likely_causes: objects retained by closures or globals
diagnostic_checks: compare heap snapshots over time
check caches without bounds
confirming_signals: specific object types grow between snapshots
warnings: scheduled restarts hide leaks and fail under peak

entries.title: Container OOMKilled
likely_causes: memory limit below real working set
diagnostic_checks: check last state termination reason
compare working set with limit
check limit changes
disconfirming_signals: termination reason different (look at liveness or crash)
safe_remediation_guidance: fix the leak or raise the memory limit to the measured need
warnings: raising limits without cause analysis delays the next OOM

example_fix.label: GENERAL EXAMPLE
example_fix.diff:
- MEMORY_LIMIT=<current limit>
+ MEMORY_LIMIT=<measured peak working set plus headroom>

entries.title: Long garbage collection pauses
likely_causes: heap too small for live data
diagnostic_checks: read GC logs for pause length and frequency
compare heap and container limits
confirming_signals: frequent full GCs near heap maximum
safe_remediation_guidance: size heap to working set with headroom
warnings: heap larger than container limit causes OOM kills

entries.title: Worker or thread pool exhaustion
symptoms: requests queue while CPU is low
diagnostic_checks: check busy versus idle workers
dump stacks to see what workers wait on
confirming_signals: all workers waiting on the same dependency
safe_remediation_guidance: add timeouts to the slow dependency
size the pool to concurrency needs
warnings: bigger pools can overload the dependency

entries.title: Node.js event loop blocked
likely_causes: synchronous CPU work on the main thread
large JSON parse or regex backtracking
diagnostic_checks: measure event loop lag
profile to find synchronous hot functions
safe_remediation_guidance: move heavy work to worker threads or async chunks
warnings: one slow request blocks every other request in Node

entries.title: Too many open files (EMFILE)
diagnostic_checks: count open descriptors of the process over time
compare with the limit
confirming_signals: descriptor count grows to the limit
warnings: raising the limit only delays exhaustion from a leak

entries.title: Ephemeral port exhaustion on outbound calls
symptoms: outbound calls fail at high rate
likely_causes: new connection per request without keep-alive
diagnostic_checks: count sockets in TIME_WAIT
check client connection reuse
confirming_signals: thousands of TIME_WAIT sockets to one destination
warnings: kernel tweaks mask the missing reuse

entries.title: Disk full from logs
diagnostic_checks: find the largest directories
check log level and rotation
common_failed_actions: restarting services which refill the disk
warnings: deleting open log files may not free space until processes reopen them

entries.title: Inode exhaustion while disk has free space
symptoms: no space left on device although free space exists
likely_causes: many tiny temp or cache files
diagnostic_checks: check inode usage per filesystem
find directories with most files
safe_remediation_guidance: use a filesystem with more inodes
warnings: some filesystems cannot add inodes without recreation

entries.title: Disk I/O saturation
likely_causes: burst of writes from batch job
diagnostic_checks: check I/O wait and device utilisation
correlate with jobs
check provisioned IOPS
warnings: cloud disks may throttle after burst credits run out

entries.title: Pods in CrashLoopBackOff
likely_causes: liveness probe killing a slow starter
diagnostic_checks: read logs of the previous container instance
check last termination reason and exit code
check events for probe failures
confirming_signals: previous logs show a startup exception or missing setting
disconfirming_signals: exits caused by OOMKilled or liveness (see those entries)
safe_remediation_guidance: fix the startup error or configuration
add a startup probe for slow starts
warnings: backoff delays grow, so recovery after the fix can take minutes

entries.title: ImagePullBackOff or ErrImagePull
diagnostic_checks: describe the pod to read the pull error
verify the tag exists
check pull secret validity
confirming_signals: error says not found or unauthorized
disconfirming_signals: pull succeeds manually from the node
safe_remediation_guidance: mirror images to avoid rate limits
warnings: latest tags make rollbacks unreliable

entries.title: Readiness probe failing after deploy
likely_causes: readiness endpoint depends on a failing dependency
diagnostic_checks: call the readiness endpoint inside the pod
compare probe settings with the app port and path
confirming_signals: probe endpoint returns errors or wrong port
disconfirming_signals: endpoint healthy but pods still not ready (check probe timing)
safe_remediation_guidance: make readiness reflect only what the instance needs
warnings: readiness depending on shared dependencies can remove every pod at once

entries.title: Liveness probe restarting healthy but slow pods
diagnostic_checks: check events for liveness failures
compare probe timeout with response time under load
common_failed_actions: increasing replicas while probe keeps killing pods
warnings: liveness restarts during load can cascade

entries.title: Pods pending: insufficient resources
symptoms: events say insufficient cpu or memory
likely_causes: requests larger than any node can fit
diagnostic_checks: read scheduling events for the pod
compare requests with node allocatable
confirming_signals: events show insufficient resources or unmatched selectors
warnings: overcommitted requests cause evictions later

entries.title: Pods evicted for node disk pressure
likely_causes: image and log accumulation on nodes
diagnostic_checks: check node conditions
check image and log disk usage on nodes
common_failed_actions: adding nodes that later fill too
warnings: evictions can take down many replicas at once

entries.title: Missing ConfigMap or Secret value after deploy
symptoms: pods fail at start with missing setting
works in one environment not another
likely_causes: new key not added to the production Secret or ConfigMap
diagnostic_checks: diff environment configuration between namespaces
list keys referenced by the deployment
safe_remediation_guidance: validate config in the pipeline before rollout
warnings: secrets in plain logs during debugging leak credentials

entries.title: Rollout stuck: new replicas never become available
symptoms: old and new versions both running
likely_causes: new pods failing readiness or crashing
diagnostic_checks: check rollout status and new pod states
disconfirming_signals: new pods ready but rollout paused
safe_remediation_guidance: fix the new version or roll back
warnings: forcing a rollout can drop capacity

entries.title: Autoscaler not scaling or flapping
likely_causes: requests not set so utilisation unknown
diagnostic_checks: check autoscaler status and current metrics
confirm resource requests set
common_failed_actions: setting a huge fixed replica count permanently
warnings: scaling a service can overload its database

entries.title: Intermittent DNS failures inside the cluster
diagnostic_checks: check DNS pod errors and latency
test lookups from an affected pod
warnings: many search domains multiply queries

entries.title: Service has no endpoints
likely_causes: selector no longer matches pod labels
diagnostic_checks: compare service selector with pod labels
list endpoints
warnings: label changes in templates silently detach services

entries.title: Ingress returns 502 or 504
symptoms: service works from inside the cluster
likely_causes: ingress points to wrong service port
diagnostic_checks: check ingress backend service and port
check ingress controller logs
confirming_signals: port mismatch or upstream errors in controller logs
warnings: annotations differ between ingress controllers

entries.title: Volume mount failures
diagnostic_checks: read pod events for mount errors
check volume attachment and zone
confirming_signals: volume still attached to an old node
warnings: deleting volumes loses data

entries.title: Container permission denied at runtime
diagnostic_checks: check security context user and filesystem settings
check ownership of the path
safe_remediation_guidance: set proper ownership or a writable volume
warnings: running as root widens attack surface

entries.title: Container exits immediately after start
diagnostic_checks: read container logs
inspect exit code
run the image interactively
confirming_signals: command not found or config error in logs
disconfirming_signals: container stays up when run manually with same env
warnings: exit code 137 usually means killed, not an app error

entries.title: Configuration value changed in a release
symptoms: a limit or setting behaves differently
likely_causes: config file or template changed a value
default applied because a key was renamed
diagnostic_checks: diff runtime configuration against the last known-good release
list keys renamed or removed
confirming_signals: a value differs from the previous release
common_failed_actions: rolling back code while config stays changed
safe_remediation_guidance: add config diff to release review
warnings: config often lives outside the code rollback path

entries.title: Environment variable missing or renamed
likely_causes: variable renamed in code but not in deploy config
build pipeline no longer sets it
diagnostic_checks: print the effective config at startup without secrets
compare with expected keys
confirming_signals: expected key absent in runtime environment
common_failed_actions: setting it by hand on one instance
safe_remediation_guidance: set the variable in deploy config
fail startup when required keys are missing
warnings: never print secret values when checking env

entries.title: Feature flag default flipped
symptoms: errors in a new code path
diagnostic_checks: check flag values and audit log
compare with previous values
confirming_signals: flag changed at the incident start
warnings: flag changes bypass normal deploy review

entries.title: Service calls the wrong environment
likely_causes: build-time variable baked in from the wrong environment
diagnostic_checks: inspect the built artifact or runtime config for base URLs
safe_remediation_guidance: add a check that fails on wrong environment
warnings: frontend bundles bake env at build time

entries.title: Canary healthy but full rollout fails
likely_causes: configuration differs between canary and main environments
capacity only insufficient at full scale
diagnostic_checks: diff configuration between canary and production
compare resource usage at scale
safe_remediation_guidance: include config parity in canary checks
warnings: canaries only catch what they share with production

entries.title: Infrastructure change removed a rule
likely_causes: firewall or security group rule removed by drift correction
diagnostic_checks: review the infrastructure plan output
compare network rules before and after
warnings: manual changes are erased by the next apply

entries.title: Rollback did not fix the incident
likely_causes: cause is external or in data or configuration not covered by rollback
diagnostic_checks: check dependencies, certificates and config independent of the release
compare error signatures
confirming_signals: errors reference a dependency or certificate
warnings: timing correlation is not causation

entries.title: New code incompatible with database schema
symptoms: errors on some instances during rollout
likely_causes: code deployed before migration or migration not backward compatible
diagnostic_checks: check migration status versus code version on each instance
common_failed_actions: rolling back code after an irreversible migration
warnings: mixed versions run together during rollouts

entries.title: Credential rotated but one consumer not updated
symptoms: one service gets 401 or authentication failed
likely_causes: service still using old credential from its own secret store
diagnostic_checks: list every consumer of the credential
check which ones received the new value
warnings: never paste credentials into tickets or chat

entries.title: Dependency or framework upgrade changed behaviour
diagnostic_checks: diff lockfile
read changelog of changed libraries
reproduce with old version
safe_remediation_guidance: pin the working version or adapt code to new defaults
warnings: lockfiles prevent surprise transitive upgrades

entries.title: Timezone or daylight saving time bug
symptoms: jobs run an hour early or late
likely_causes: local time used where UTC was needed
diagnostic_checks: compare scheduler timezone with job expectations
check timestamps around the change
warnings: some hours do not exist or repeat on change days

entries.title: Wrong commit or branch deployed
symptoms: expected fix not present in production
diagnostic_checks: compare deployed commit hash with the intended one
safe_remediation_guidance: show commit hash in health endpoint
warnings: moving tags breaks traceability

entries.title: Hostname does not resolve after DNS change
symptoms: NXDOMAIN or could not resolve host
diagnostic_checks: query each authoritative nameserver directly
compare records with the old zone
warnings: negative answers are cached too

entries.title: Stale DNS answers after a record change
symptoms: some users reach the old address
likely_causes: long TTL on the old record
diagnostic_checks: check TTL of the old record
query several public resolvers
confirming_signals: resolvers return old address within TTL
safe_remediation_guidance: keep old target serving until TTL expires
warnings: some clients ignore TTLs

entries.title: DNS provider outage
diagnostic_checks: query authoritative servers
check provider status page
safe_remediation_guidance: add a secondary DNS provider with synced records
warnings: registrar nameserver changes take time

entries.title: Split-horizon DNS returns wrong internal address
symptoms: service reachable externally but not internally
diagnostic_checks: resolve from inside and outside the network and compare
warnings: hosts file overrides are forgotten

entries.title: Certificate expired
diagnostic_checks: check certificate expiry date on the live endpoint
check renewal job logs and validation
confirming_signals: live certificate not after date is in the past
warnings: internal dependency certificates expire unnoticed

entries.title: Incomplete certificate chain
symptoms: unable to verify the first certificate
works in browsers but fails in some clients
diagnostic_checks: inspect the presented chain with a strict client
confirming_signals: only the leaf certificate is presented
warnings: browsers may hide chain problems by caching intermediates

entries.title: Hostname mismatch in certificate
likely_causes: certificate lacks the name in subject alternative names
diagnostic_checks: list SAN entries on the presented certificate
safe_remediation_guidance: issue a certificate including the hostname
warnings: disabling verification exposes traffic to interception

entries.title: Mobile apps fail after certificate authority change
symptoms: after certificate renewal with new CA
likely_causes: apps pin the old CA or key
diagnostic_checks: compare pinned keys in the app with the new certificate chain
confirming_signals: new chain not in pin set
warnings: pin changes need app releases in advance

entries.title: mTLS failures after CA rotation
symptoms: unknown certificate authority errors between services
diagnostic_checks: check which trust bundle each failing service loads
common_failed_actions: restarting one service at a time without updating bundles
safe_remediation_guidance: distribute a bundle containing old and new CA during rotation
warnings: rotating without overlap breaks traffic

entries.title: TLS handshake failure: protocol or cipher mismatch
likely_causes: server disabled protocols or ciphers clients need
diagnostic_checks: test handshake with the failing client's protocol versions
warnings: weak protocols have known attacks

entries.title: Certificate renewals hitting CA rate limits
symptoms: rate limit errors from certificate authority
likely_causes: renewal loop or mass reissue exceeded limits
diagnostic_checks: check renewal logs for rate limit errors
count issuance attempts
warnings: limits reset slowly

entries.title: Tokens rejected as not yet valid or expired: clock skew
symptoms: token not yet valid or expired errors
diagnostic_checks: compare clocks across hosts
check time sync service
confirming_signals: clock offset of minutes on failing hosts
warnings: allowing big skew weakens token security

entries.title: JWT signature invalid after signing key rotation
symptoms: about a fraction of logins fail
likely_causes: some issuers or verifiers still use the old key
kid not published in key set
diagnostic_checks: decode failing tokens and check kid
compare with published keys on every instance
safe_remediation_guidance: publish old and new keys during overlap
warnings: never log token contents in full

entries.title: OAuth redirect URI mismatch
likely_causes: registered redirect URI differs from the one sent
diagnostic_checks: compare the redirect URI in the authorize request with the registered list
warnings: wildcard redirects enable token theft

entries.title: Access token refresh failing
symptoms: users logged out after token lifetime
diagnostic_checks: inspect refresh error codes
check client credentials and rotation settings
confirming_signals: invalid grant for rotated refresh tokens
warnings: long-lived tokens raise risk

entries.title: Identity provider or JWKS endpoint unavailable
symptoms: token validation fails to fetch keys
likely_causes: network egress blocked to JWKS endpoint
diagnostic_checks: fetch the discovery and JWKS URLs from the service host
warnings: never skip signature validation

entries.title: Users logged out randomly
diagnostic_checks: check session store evictions
check session secret consistency across instances
warnings: rotating session secrets logs everyone out

entries.title: Login breaks after cookie attribute change
symptoms: cookie not sent on cross-site requests
likely_causes: SameSite or Secure attributes block the cookie
diagnostic_checks: inspect Set-Cookie attributes and browser warnings
safe_remediation_guidance: set SameSite=None with Secure for cross-site flows, or keep flows same-site
warnings: SameSite=None without Secure is rejected

entries.title: SAML or SSO assertion rejected
diagnostic_checks: check assertion validation errors
compare IdP cert with configured cert
common_failed_actions: re-uploading metadata repeatedly without checking the error
warnings: IdP cert rotations need coordination

entries.title: Legitimate users locked out by login rate limiting
symptoms: too many attempts errors for many users
diagnostic_checks: group lockouts by source IP and account
confirming_signals: many accounts behind one IP locked
safe_remediation_guidance: key limits on account plus IP
warnings: loosening limits helps attackers

entries.title: Upstream timed out while reading response header
likely_causes: application slower than proxy read timeout
diagnostic_checks: compare app latency with proxy timeout
find slow dependency
warnings: long timeouts tie up connections

entries.title: Upstream sent too big header
symptoms: 502 with upstream sent too big header
likely_causes: proxy header buffer too small for response headers
diagnostic_checks: measure response header size from the app
safe_remediation_guidance: reduce header size or raise buffer size moderately
warnings: large headers slow every request

entries.title: Proxy worker connections exhausted
diagnostic_checks: check proxy connection metrics against limits
safe_remediation_guidance: raise worker connection limits and file descriptor limits
warnings: descriptor limits must match

entries.title: Load balancer marks all targets unhealthy
symptoms: after health check or port change
likely_causes: health check path or port changed
health endpoint depends on a failing dependency
diagnostic_checks: call the health endpoint from the load balancer network
compare path and port
warnings: deep health checks can fail every target together

entries.title: Users bounce between instances losing state
likely_causes: in-memory session state without affinity or shared store
diagnostic_checks: check where session state is stored
test with affinity
common_failed_actions: enabling affinity as permanent fix only
safe_remediation_guidance: move state to a shared store
warnings: affinity breaks during scaling

entries.title: WebSocket connections fail behind proxy
likely_causes: proxy not forwarding Upgrade and Connection headers
diagnostic_checks: inspect upgrade request and response through the proxy
safe_remediation_guidance: raise idle timeout for socket routes
warnings: load balancers may cut idle sockets

entries.title: CDN returns 5xx because origin is unreachable
likely_causes: origin firewall blocks CDN address ranges
diagnostic_checks: test origin from CDN egress
check origin TLS settings
confirming_signals: CDN cannot connect or TLS fails
warnings: CDN IP ranges change over time

entries.title: Queue backlog growing
likely_causes: consumer throughput dropped (concurrency setting, slow dependency)
diagnostic_checks: compare produce versus consume rate
check worker concurrency and per-job duration
confirming_signals: consume rate fell after a change
disconfirming_signals: consume rate steady while produce rate rose
common_failed_actions: adding workers when each only processes one job at a time
safe_remediation_guidance: restore concurrency or fix slow dependency
warnings: scaling consumers can overload shared dependencies

entries.title: Poison message crashing consumers
likely_causes: malformed message the consumer cannot handle
diagnostic_checks: find the message id present in every crash
safe_remediation_guidance: move the message to a dead-letter queue
warnings: without DLQ one message blocks a queue

entries.title: Messages processed twice: visibility timeout
likely_causes: processing exceeds visibility timeout so message redelivered
diagnostic_checks: compare processing time with visibility timeout
safe_remediation_guidance: raise timeout or extend it while processing
warnings: at-least-once delivery requires idempotency

entries.title: Consumer lag and rebalance storm
diagnostic_checks: check rebalance frequency and poll interval against batch processing time
warnings: rebalances pause all partitions

entries.title: Uneven partition load
symptoms: one consumer lagging while others idle
likely_causes: key distribution skewed to one partition
diagnostic_checks: compare lag and throughput per partition
inspect key distribution
warnings: changing partition count affects ordering

entries.title: Messages unacknowledged piling up
likely_causes: prefetch too high with slow consumers
consumer not acknowledging on error path
diagnostic_checks: check unacked counts per consumer
check ack paths
safe_remediation_guidance: ack or reject on every path
warnings: broker memory alarms block publishers

entries.title: Dead-letter queue filling up
diagnostic_checks: sample DLQ messages and their failure reasons
confirming_signals: same failure reason across DLQ messages
warnings: purging loses business events

entries.title: Scheduled job did not run: stale lock
symptoms: scheduler says another instance holds the lock
likely_causes: crashed instance left a lock without expiry
diagnostic_checks: inspect lock key, owner and TTL
confirming_signals: lock exists without TTL and owner is gone
warnings: locks without expiry block forever

entries.title: Scheduled jobs overlap and contend
symptoms: two runs of the same job at once
diagnostic_checks: compare job runtime with interval
check concurrency policy
warnings: overlapping jobs double database load

entries.title: Latency spikes at scheduled times
symptoms: spikes at the top of the hour or night
likely_causes: scheduled job running on the same nodes as the API
diagnostic_checks: align spike timestamps with job schedules
warnings: many jobs scheduled at minute zero collide

entries.title: Incoming webhooks rejected: signature mismatch
symptoms: every webhook rejected as invalid signature
likely_causes: body modified before verification (parsing or re-serialisation)
diagnostic_checks: verify against the raw request body
confirm secret
warnings: never disable signature checks

entries.title: Outgoing webhooks failing to deliver
likely_causes: DNS or TLS problem at receiver
diagnostic_checks: inspect delivery attempts and response codes
warnings: bulk replay can overwhelm receivers

entries.title: Third-party provider outage
symptoms: calls to one provider time out or fail
diagnostic_checks: check provider status page
test provider from multiple regions
safe_remediation_guidance: fail over to a secondary provider if available
warnings: fallbacks need regular testing

entries.title: Third-party API quota exceeded
diagnostic_checks: check quota usage dashboard
correlate with traffic
warnings: quota resets may be far away

entries.title: Provider changed API response format
diagnostic_checks: compare recent responses with expected schema
warnings: unpinned versions change silently

entries.title: SMS or email not delivered
symptoms: users do not receive codes or emails
diagnostic_checks: check delivery reports by country and provider
warnings: resending can trigger spam filters

entries.title: Slow dependency without timeout stalls service
symptoms: service hangs when a dependency is slow
diagnostic_checks: check client timeout configuration
dump stacks to see waiting calls
warnings: default client timeouts are often infinite

entries.title: Vendor SDK update broke integration
likely_causes: SDK changed defaults or removed options
diagnostic_checks: diff SDK versions
read release notes
warnings: auto-updating SDKs in production is risky

entries.title: Cloud region incident
symptoms: many managed services degraded in one region
diagnostic_checks: check provider status
compare regions
safe_remediation_guidance: fail over to another region if prepared
warnings: failover must be practised beforehand

entries.title: Permission denied writing files after deploy
diagnostic_checks: check process user and directory ownership
warnings: world-writable paths are insecure

entries.title: Object storage access denied
diagnostic_checks: check effective permissions of the role for the action
warnings: public buckets leak data

entries.title: Object storage quota or lifecycle problem
diagnostic_checks: check bucket size growth and lifecycle rules
confirming_signals: temp prefix huge and rule missing
warnings: deleting objects is irreversible

entries.title: Read-only filesystem errors
symptoms: after disk error or container hardening
diagnostic_checks: check mount options and kernel messages
safe_remediation_guidance: use writable volume for app data
warnings: disk errors may mean data loss

entries.title: Backups failing silently
diagnostic_checks: check last successful backup
check alert routing
warnings: untested backups are not backups

entries.title: Expired API key or client secret
likely_causes: key or secret expiry date reached
diagnostic_checks: check expiry of the credential
warnings: store secrets in a secret manager, not in code

entries.title: Node.js process crashes on unhandled promise rejection
likely_causes: missing await or catch on a failing promise
diagnostic_checks: read crash stack for the rejection origin
common_failed_actions: catching all errors globally and continuing
safe_remediation_guidance: handle the rejection at its source
warnings: swallowing errors hides data corruption

entries.title: Node.js heap out of memory
diagnostic_checks: check heap usage trend
heap snapshot
warnings: heap above container limit causes OOM kill

entries.title: Python web worker timeouts
diagnostic_checks: check which requests exceed worker timeout
warnings: long timeouts mask slow dependencies

entries.title: Asyncio event loop blocked
diagnostic_checks: enable asyncio debug mode to find slow callbacks
confirming_signals: slow callback warnings name a blocking call
warnings: one blocking call stalls every task

entries.title: Incident not detected: alert never fired
diagnostic_checks: check alert rule, metric presence and routing
confirming_signals: rule references missing metric or old route
warnings: noisy alerts get ignored

entries.title: Logs missing during incident
diagnostic_checks: check agent health and ingestion lag
warnings: debug logging can fill disks

entries.title: Service-to-service timeouts after network change
symptoms: no errors from the services themselves
likely_causes: firewall or network policy blocks traffic
diagnostic_checks: test connectivity between the pair
review recent network policy changes
confirming_signals: connection attempts time out without response
warnings: timeouts rather than refusals suggest dropped packets

entries.title: Large requests hang: MTU mismatch
symptoms: small requests work, large ones hang
after VPN or overlay network change
diagnostic_checks: test with increasing packet sizes
confirming_signals: packets above a size are dropped
safe_remediation_guidance: align MTU or enable path MTU discovery
warnings: MTU issues look like random hangs

entries.title: Checkout fails after release
symptoms: checkout errors right after a release
likely_causes: configuration regression such as database pool or connection settings
diagnostic_checks: compare deployment configuration with the previous version
check database connection saturation
check payment and dependency error rates
confirming_signals: a changed setting or saturated database connections
disconfirming_signals: configuration identical and database healthy (look at dependencies)
safe_remediation_guidance: roll back if a code regression
warnings: the same symptoms have several different causes

entries.title: Init container failing blocks pod start
likely_causes: init container waits on unreachable dependency
diagnostic_checks: read init container logs
check dependency reachability
confirming_signals: init logs show failure or waiting
safe_remediation_guidance: fix the dependency or init command
warnings: init containers block the whole pod

entries.title: Network policy blocks traffic after change
symptoms: pods cannot reach a service after policy change
diagnostic_checks: list network policies selecting the pods
test connectivity
warnings: removing policies weakens isolation

entries.title: Evictions from memory pressure on nodes
likely_causes: pods without memory requests overcommit nodes
diagnostic_checks: check node memory and pod requests versus usage
safe_remediation_guidance: set realistic memory requests and limits
warnings: best-effort pods are evicted first

entries.title: gRPC deadline exceeded errors
diagnostic_checks: trace calls to see where time is spent
compare deadlines at each hop
warnings: no deadlines leads to piled-up requests

entries.title: gRPC unavailable after server restart
diagnostic_checks: check client connection distribution across servers
safe_remediation_guidance: enable client-side balancing or connection max age
warnings: HTTP/2 multiplexing hides imbalance

entries.title: Our own gateway throttling legitimate traffic
diagnostic_checks: compare gateway limits with the previous configuration
check keying
confirming_signals: new limit lower or keyed on shared attribute
warnings: removing limits exposes backends

entries.title: Secret accidentally exposed in logs
symptoms: credential found in logs or tickets
likely_causes: debug logging printing headers or env
diagnostic_checks: search logs for the credential pattern
find the logging code path
warnings: assume an exposed secret is compromised

entries.title: Application caches DNS forever
symptoms: service keeps calling old IP after DNS change
likely_causes: runtime or client caches DNS without honouring TTL
diagnostic_checks: check client DNS caching settings
safe_remediation_guidance: configure DNS cache TTL in the runtime
warnings: some runtimes cache indefinitely by default

entries.title: Clients reject certificate from private CA
symptoms: certificate verify failed from some services
likely_causes: private CA not in client trust store
new base image without CA bundle
diagnostic_checks: check trust store contents in client image
safe_remediation_guidance: add CA to trust store in image
warnings: disabling verification enables interception

entries.title: Payments declined for one currency
likely_causes: minor unit conversion wrong for zero-decimal currencies
diagnostic_checks: compare sent amounts with expected for affected currency
warnings: test zero-decimal currencies explicitly
